description: Signature Base64 contains an embedded ASCII space character. Per docs/spec-evidence.md §4.1.2, whitespace anywhere in the encoded value (leading, trailing, or embedded) is non-conformant. Under v0.9.0a2 _b64decode rejects via the any(ch.isspace()) pre-check (Phase 2.3), stricter than the prior 'leading/trailing only' check.
source: Wire-representation strictness follow-through of MAINT-F2: whitespace anywhere in the Base64 signature must be rejected. Per docs/spec-evidence.md §4.1.2 the encoded value is validated as represented on the wire — no leading, trailing, or embedded whitespace. v0.9.0a2 adds an any(ch.isspace()) pre-check in Phase 2.3.
